messages:
Priya: FYI I opened a PR to slim down the JSON Schema examples in the function/tool-calling guide. The big verbose example was confusing for users; this replaces it with a compact canonical example + a short expanded example in a collapsible block. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321 :wave:
Sam: Nice. Do we have a migration note for SDK users? I worry the compact shape could look like a breaking change if someone copies the big example directly into production. :eyes:
Priya: Good point. I added a short 'migration' note at the top of the section and a quick checklist for authors: preserve top-level keys, prefer enums over long prose, and include a runnable SDK snippet. See the diff: `- huge example` -> `+ compact shape + optional expanded example`.
Evan: Happy to update the Node + Python snippets. Which auth pattern should the snippets use? API key or the new client?
Priya: Use the new client pattern (recommended) but add a one-line alternative showing API key usage for quick copy. Example to add:
```js
const client = new RedwoodClient({ auth: process.env.RW_API_KEY });
const res = await client.callTool({ name: 'search', input: { q: 'how to migrate' } });
```
Sam: Could we also show a tiny parse example for structured output? Like `const out = JSON.parse(res.output)` and a quick guardrail check for missing fields. Keeps it pragmatic.
Priya: Yup added: `if (!out.result) throw new Error('missing result')` and a note about schema validation libraries.
Marta: Heads-up — the TOC crosslink to the 'structured outputs' page changed when we moved the example. I have a small follow-up PR queued to patch crossrefs and the 'see also' links across the SDK pages. Will link both PRs here.
Marta: Link to TOC fix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4330
Sam: CI on #4321? I ran the local docs build and it shows one formatting nit in the Python snippet (blank line inside code block). I'll push a tiny fix unless someone else wants it.
CI-bot: build #4321 passed (html lint: warnings: 1) - see https://ci.redwood-inference.internal/builds/9876
Evan: I'll take the SDK snippet changes in #4321 and add tests to the snippets harness so we don't regress formatting. Assign me for followups.
Priya: Awesome. Action items: Evan update Node/Python snippets + add snippet tests; Marta patch crosslinks in #4330; Sam apply formatting nitfix; Priya to add the migration note and the example toggles. I'll request review from @docs-team and @sdk-maintainers later today. :shipit:
Sam: Reviewing now, leaving inline comments on the PR.
Marta: Thanks — once both PRs merge I'll run a quick site search to ensure no old giant examples remain.
Priya: Thanks team. Planning to merge after review and CI green. If anyone sees regressions after merge please ping here.
